00048 void SpectrumDesigner::design (Pandora::spectralType type, 
00049     std::vector <double> params) {
00050     switch (type) {
00051         case Pandora::RANDOM_SPECTRUM:
00052             for (long x = 0; x < m_partials; x++) {
00053                 double freq = (m_rand->tick () * (m_max - m_min)) + m_min;
00054                 double amp = (m_rand->tick ()  * (1.0 / (double) m_partials));      
00055                 double phi = m_rand->tick ();   
00056                 m_bank[x]->amplitude (amp);
00057                 m_bank[x]->frequency (freq);
00058                 m_bank[x]->phase (phi);         
00059             }               
00060         break;
00061         case Pandora::ALPHA_SPECTRUM: {
00062             if (params.size () < 1) return;
00063             
00064             double alpha = params[0];
00065             double c1 = (m_max - m_min);
00066             if (alpha == 0.0) {
00067                 c1 /= m_partials;
00068             }
00069             else {
00070                 c1 /= (1.0 - (double) exp ((double) alpha));
00071             }
00072     
00073             alpha /= m_partials;
00074             double curr = alpha;
00075             double freq = m_min;
00076             double amp = (1.0 / (double) m_partials);
00077             m_bank[0]->frequency (m_min);
00078             m_bank[0]->amplitude (amp);
00079             m_bank[0]->phase (0);
00080             for (long x = 1; x < m_partials; x++) {
00081                 if (alpha == 0.0) {
00082                     freq += c1;
00083                     }
00084                 else {
00085                     freq = m_min + c1 * (1.0 - (double) exp ((double) (curr)));
00086                 }
00087     
00088                 m_bank[x]->amplitude (amp);
00089                 m_bank[x]->frequency (freq);
00090                 m_bank[x]->phase (0);
00091                 
00092                 curr += alpha;
00093             }               
00094         }
00095         break;
00096         case Pandora::LISSAJOUS_SPECTRUM: {
00097             if (params.size () < 2) return;
00098             
00099             double alpha = params[0];
00100             double beta = params[1];
00101             
00102             for (long x = 0; x < m_partials; x++) {
00103                 double freq = fabs (m_max * sin (alpha * x) * cos (beta * x)) 
00104                     + m_min;
00105                 double amp = fabs ((1.0 / (double) m_partials) * 
00106                     sin (alpha * x) * sin (beta * x));
00107                 m_bank[x]->amplitude (amp);
00108                 m_bank[x]->frequency (freq);
00109                 m_bank[x]->phase (0);       
00110             }           
00111         }
00112         break;
00113         case Pandora::POLY_SPECTRUM: {
00114             double plotDelta = 200;
00115             double plotIncr = plotDelta / m_partials;
00116             double plotFreq = -100;
00117     
00118             std::vector <double> amps;
00119             std::vector <double> freqs;
00120             double plotMin = 0, plotMax = 0; 
00121     
00122             std::reverse (params.begin (), params.end ());
00123             for (long x = 0; x < m_partials; x++) {
00124                 int n = params.size () - 1, j;
00125                 double p = params[j = n];
00126             
00127                 while (j > 0) {
00128                     p = (p * plotFreq + params[--j]);
00129                 }
00130         
00131                 amps.push_back (p);
00132                 if (p <= plotMin) plotMin = p;
00133                 if (p >= plotMax) plotMax = p;
00134     
00135                 freqs.push_back (plotFreq);
00136                 plotFreq += plotIncr;
00137             }
00138             
00139             double ampStep = (1.0 / (double) m_partials);
00140             double freqDelta = m_max - m_min;
00141             for (long x = 0; x < m_partials; x++) {
00142                 m_bank[x]->amplitude (((amps[x] + fabs (plotMin)) / (plotMax - plotMin)) * ampStep);
00143                 m_bank[x]->frequency (((freqs[x] + 100) / 200) * freqDelta + m_min);
00144                 m_bank[x]->phase (0);
00145             }
00146         }   
00147         break;
00148         case Pandora::FMLIKE_SPECTRUM: {
00149             double modulator = (m_max - m_min) / (double) m_partials;
00150             // index == partials !!
00151             double amps[m_partials];
00152             for (long x = 0; x < m_partials; x++) {
00153                 long bessOrd = abs (((m_partials / 2) - x));
00154                 amps[x] = fabs (jn (bessOrd, m_partials));
00155             }       
00156             double norm = amps[0];
00157             for (long x = 0; x < m_partials; x++) {
00158                 if (amps[x] >= norm) { norm = amps[x]; }
00159             }       
00160             
00161             double ampFrac = (1.0 / (double) m_partials);   
00162             for (long x = 0; x < m_partials; x++) {
00163                 double freq = m_min + (x * modulator);
00164                 double amp = (amps[x] / norm) * ampFrac;
00165                 m_bank[x]->amplitude (fabs (amp));
00166                 m_bank[x]->frequency (freq);
00167                 m_bank[x]->phase (0);
00168             }               
00169         }
00170         break;
00171     }

00174 void SpectrumDesigner::purify (double ratio) {
00175     for (long x = 0; x < m_partials; x++) {
00176         for (long j = x + 1; j < m_partials; j++) {
00177             if (m_bank[j]->frequency () / m_bank[x]->frequency () <= ratio) {
00178                 m_bank[x]->amplitude (0);
00179             }
00180         }
00181     }
